A Supergasbras é uma empresa do grupo holandês SHV Energy, líder mundial na distribuição de Gás liquefeito de Petróleo (GLP), com mais de 100 anos de experiência. Nosso negócio é levar energia limpa e eficiente para milhões de brasileiros, seja nas suas casas, comércios, indústrias ou agronegócio. Desenvolvemos uma série de projetos com foco em transformação digital, experiência do cliente, inovação e desenvolvimento sustentável do negócio. Nossa estratégia é conseguir através da confiança e integridade, ser a melhor empresa de Energia do Brasil para nossos clientes, parceiros, colaboradores e acionistas, com responsabilidade socioambiental.

Diversidade e inclusão é uma prioridade de negócios para a Supergasbras. Valorizamos e acreditamos no desenvolvimento de pessoas, tanto no contexto profissional como pessoal, tendo como estratégia a equidade de gênero, inclusão de pessoas com deficiência, respeito a todas as orientações sexuais e luta contra a discriminação racial nas diferentes camadas da sociedade.

Ser diverso é ser Super!

Esta oportunidade também está publicada no portal global de vagas da SHV Energy e faz parte do nosso compromisso de atrair talentos que compartilham dos nossos valores, independente da localização.

Responsabilidades e atribuições Objetivo do Cargo

A posição de Especialista Tributário tem como objetivo liderar tecnicamente as estratégias de compliance e defesa tributária da empresa, com foco em tributos federais diretos (especialmente IRPJ e CSLL), atuando de forma proativa na gestão de riscos, na condução de processos de contencioso administrativo, interpretação e normatização de legislação federal e na identificação de oportunidades fiscais. Este profissional será referência técnica na área, com papel consultivo e estratégico junto às demais áreas da empresa e escritórios externos.

Responsabilidades do Cargo
  • Liderar tecnicamente a apuração e revisão dos tributos federais diretos (especialmente IRPJ e CSLL),
  • Coordenar métodos de revisão de obrigações acessórias federais (ECF, ECD, EFD-Contribuições, DCTFWeb, PER/DCOMP, REINF, entre outras) atuando ocasionalmente na sua elaboração.
  • Atuar diretamente na condução de processos administrativos tributários, elaborando defesas, recursos e acompanhando julgamentos e fiscalizações em geral.
  • Desenvolver e implementar melhorias nos processos tributários, com foco em automação e eficiência, gestão de metas e indicadores da área, aprimorando suas habilidades para um perfil crítico e analítico.
  • Representar a empresa junto a órgãos públicos e escritórios jurídicos em temas tributários.
  • Monitorar e interpretar mudanças na legislação tributária federal, em especial a Reforma Tributária, propondo estratégias de adequação de processos internos e aproveitamento de oportunidades.
  • Ser membro ativo e protagonista dos impactos da Reforma Tributária do Consumo (e outras reformas) desde a interpretação da legislação até adequações sistêmicas.
  • Apoiar em planejamento tributário, projetos especiais e na estruturação de operações com impacto fiscal.
  • Participar de comitês internos e reuniões estratégicas com áreas como Jurídico, Contabilidade, Planejamento Financeiro e Negócios e correlatas.
  • Atuar como mentor técnico para analistas da área.
  • Garantir o alinhamento técnico e elaboração de reportes para e com a matriz internacional.
  • Atendimento a auditorias externas/internas.

Ensino Superior completo em Ciências Contábeis, Direito, Administração ou áreas correlatas.

title: Executivo(a) de Vendas Long Tail
description:
About The Company

Se para você a tecnologia existe para melhorar o caminho da vida, para o nosso time também: Seu Caminho, Nossa Jornada.

Acreditamos na tecnologia que conecta gente boa no que faz e que vive a diversidade para criar e compartilhar até os caminhos que a gente (ainda!) nem sabe quais são. Trabalhamos para gerar valor não só para os nossos usuários, mas, sobretudo, para as comunidades que servimos e toda a sociedade, tornando a vida das pessoas melhor com serviços que facilitem seu dia a dia - seja com serviços de mobilidade e entrega (99) ou pagamentos digitais (99Pay).

Para facilitar a vida de milhões de pessoas todos os dias, desde 2018 fazemos parte da DiDi Global Inc., a maior plataforma de tecnologia e transporte por aplicativo do mundo. Somos pioneiros na criação de soluções inovadoras que começam no Brasil e que ganham escala para gerar impacto positivo em mais de 12 países em que a DiDi está presente. Essas inovações passam por sustentabilidade, segurança, inteligência artificial, mercado financeiro e um tanto mais.

Seja para construir projetos do zero ou aprimorar nossas soluções, gostamos de desafios que nos fazem sentir frio na barriga, e é por isso que trabalhamos num ritmo acelerado, com respeito, colaboração e bom humor. Nessa jornada, também nos fortalecemos nas diferentes vivências e opiniões para crescermos juntos, errar rápido, aprender e ajustar o caminho para criar soluções que tragam ainda melhores resultados.

About The Team/role

Our Sales Coordinators will work in DriverLab’s team, focused on innovation projects for our drivers. Being part of the DriverLab team will give you the unique opportunity to help drive growth in one of the fastest growing companies ever.

This role is based on developing new partnerships, coordinating the sales vertical in a new region, leading the acquisition and the partnership development, through the deal with gas stations to join the new 99’s marketplace: 99Abastece. Be prepared for a fast‑paced, challenging and joyful environment.

In this role, you'll be

  • Focus on great execution with the sales team to develop new partnerships on the 99Abastece business, being responsible for the initial contact stage, until the completion of the onboarding process and the engagement dynamics.
  • Support team management: manage acquisition, activation and support team (third party).
  • Close relationship with portfolio customers, promoting a good experience and strategic consulting for partners, aiming at greater profitability.
  • Ensure collaboration with stakeholders teams to improve operational productivity (marketing, S&Ops, HR, legal, procurement).
  • Create a fun, inclusive, and safe work culture: you will help build a hard‑working, challenging but fun workplace and be responsible for ensuring engagement and development of your team.

We're eager to be in touch because you have

  • 4 – 5 years of experience in sales B2B/B2C, fuel market, food delivery, strategy consulting or other professional services with a proven track record in using data to drive business decisions.
  • Great ability of negotiation and relationship.
  • Availability for business travels around twice a month.
  • Experience in team management.
  • Proven self‑motivation, self‑direction, and eagerness to take ownership of tasks to ensure solutions.
  • Intermediate English knowledge: the position may require eventual interaction with international stakeholders living in Brazil and abroad.
  • Distinctive problem‑solving ability – to break down ambiguous problems, put structure and use data‑driven insights to solve them.
  • Clear communication – you are a clear and concise communicator with the ability to synthesize a lot of information quickly and highlight the key insights.
  • Comfortable learning and using new software tools and working in a business with constant changes.

You’ll love working at DiDi because

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data‑driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win‑win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a vision of the future or something we wish to have one day, it is a non‑negotiable value of who we are. We practice inclusion, plurality, and respect. And we count on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works together with HR, leadership and identity groups – 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres, and 99Mamães. This part of our journey has been written, there remains a long road before us.

We reinforce that this position is open to everyone, including pregnant people and people with disabilities (PwD).

Nossos principais valores são segurança, sustentabilidade, integridade, atendimento, resultado, inovação e gente. Temos como estratégia a contratação de pessoas com deficiência e outros públicos diversos, como mulheres, negros, e o público LGBTQI+A+.

Descrição Resumida:

Buscamos um(a) Coordenador(a) de Operações para atuar na gestão de contratos e desempenho da frota offshore, com foco em embarcações do tipo AHTS. Será responsável por garantir a eficiência operacional, conformidade regulatória, controle de custos e relacionamento com o cliente. Experiência direta com AHTS será considerada um diferencial, mas não é um requisito eliminatório.

Descrição Detalhada:

  1. Garantir o cumprimento dos requisitos internos, contratuais e legais no desenvolvimento das operações, por meio do acompanhamento das atividades operacionais e da atuação no gerenciamento dos processos, incluindo estabelecimento de ações preventivas e corretivas;
  2. Assegurar a manutenção da operacionalidade da frota de embarcações, por meio da participação nos processos de planejamento, decisão e interface com o cliente e interação com os departamentos de suporte quando necessário (suprimentos, manutenção, engenharia, QSMS e RH marítimo);
  3. Aumentar a eficiência, rentabilidade e segurança da operação da frota de embarcações, por meio do acompanhamento dos indicadores de desempenho, da realização de análises críticas e indicação e desenvolvimento de projetos de melhorias para os processos, através do estreito relacionamento com o departamento de QSMS a fim de garantir o cumprimento das diretrizes de segurança e procedimentos internos da companhia, assim como atuação no processo de investigação de acidentes;
  4. Garantir atendimento e satisfação dos clientes, por meio de um bom relacionamento, conhecimento dos requisitos estabelecidos, acompanhamento dos índices de avaliação de desempenho, realização de análises críticas desses resultados e indicação de melhorias para os processos, assim como estar atento a tendência e projetos de melhoria para maior satisfação ao cliente;
  5. Assegurar o cumprimento do orçamento de custos e receitas da gerência de operações, por meio da participação nos processos de orçamento, análise crítica dos resultados e indicação de ações preventivas e corretivas, assim como emissão de relatórios de medição do serviço e reembolso, acompanhamento do processo até o pagamento junto com o setor financeiro;
  6. Preservar a saúde e segurança dos colaboradores e parceiros, bem como a preservação ambiental, no desenvolvimento das operações, por meio da participação nos processos de análise de riscos, definição de medidas de controle, elaboração de procedimentos e fornecimento de orientações;
  7. Apoiar no desenvolvimento da equipe, por meio de planejamento e acompanhamento do Planejamento de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI), a fim de conduzir o crescimento dentro da organização;
  8. Assegurar retorno a operacionalidade das embarcações em situações de downtime, através de coordenação das necessidades da embarcação e negociação com cliente com o objetivo de reverter o downtime com a menor perda possível de faturamento, assim como a execução e envio de relatórios técnicos ao cliente;
  9. Controlar e garantir atendimento das ações e pendências com o cliente e órgãos reguladores, acompanhamento do processo no sistema SISPEN, GINSP (PETROBRAS), controle de cartas, agrupando as informações de todas as áreas envolvidas;

Coordenar os projetos de conversão/modificação das embarcações para estejam de acordo com os requisitos contratados pelo cliente, planejando junto as áreas de apoio (Engenharia, Suprimentos e Docagem) todas as entregas relacionadas a projeto, materiais e obra da embarcação dentro do prazo e atendendo ao escopo solicitado;
  11. Cumprir e implementar as determinações estabelecidas pela companhia, na busca da melhoria da Qualidade, Segurança (Ocupacional e Operacional), Saúde e Proteção Ambiental, prevenção e combate à poluição e/ou eliminação das não conformidades, visando a excelência operacional.

Account Executive Sênior - Hunter (Híbrido/SP)

Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas! A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.


O time do Comercial Digital (Pagar.me):

Construímos o Pagar.me em 2014 para mudar a forma de receber pagamentos pela internet. Nos tornamos uma empresa do grupo Stone Co. e atuamos para ajudar lojistas de todos os tamanhos e modelos de negócio, desde pequenas lojas e startups a grandes e-commerces e marketplaces, a possuir uma estrutura de pagamentos digital poderosa e flexível.

Como é ser um(a) Account Executive - Hunter (Hibrido/SP):

A missão do(a) Hunter é impactar positivamente o resultado e a expansão da empresa, com um grande foco em fortalecer o posicionamento da marca e criar relacionamentos duradouros com os(as) clientes.

Assim, o desafio consiste em atuar na prospecção passiva, negociação e finalização do funil de vendas, convertendo os(as) leads já qualificados(as) pelo time de SDR (prospecção e qualificação de leads) e também buscar novos clientes através de prospecção ativa, negociando e fechando propostas comerciais coerentes.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Mapear e-commerces compatíveis com o produto e features do Pagar.me.
  • Prospectar e-commerces e gerar interesse no(a) cliente em conhecer nosso produto.
  • Diagnosticar um problema/oportunidade na operação do(a) cliente e conectar a resolução do problema/oportunidade com as features do Pagar.me.
  • Negociar e vender consultivamente nossos produtos, construindo e entregando ao(à) cliente a melhor solução possível.
  • Credenciar os(as) clientes no nosso sistema.
  • Gerir e acompanhar o(a) cliente durante todo o processo de venda, até o fechamento da proposta;
  • Fazer a gestão da carteira de clientes para identificar possíveis melhorias no serviço, aproximar relacionamento e identificar oportunidades de venda;

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência na área comercial e com Inside Sales;
  • Experiência com prospecção ativa e habilidade para gerar oportunidades aderentes;
  • Conhecimento e aplicação das técnicas de venda (Spin Selling por exemplo);

title: FF&E Supply chain Manager
description:
This position will work closely with Interior Designers and Senior FF&E Procurement Manager to maintain FF&E budgets, project procurement, supply chain, logistics and project installations.

We are seeking a highly organized and experienced FF&E Supply Chain Project Manager to oversee the full logistics, quality control, and delivery process for a luxury residential hospitality project in Brazil. This role is responsible for managing production follow-up, factory coordination, inbound logistics from multiple regions (Brazil and Europe), storage operations in Preá, and final‑mile delivery into Jericoacoara—an area with challenging access conditions.

The ideal candidate has strong project management skills, experience in complex supply‑chain environments, and the ability to work collaboratively with vendors, factories, construction teams, installers, and logistics partners.

At a Glance:

  1. Mid–Senior role overseeing end‑to‑end FF&E supply chain for a luxury hospitality project in Brazil
  2. Responsible for factory supervision, quality control, and production sign‑off (Brazil & Europe)
  3. Manages storage operations in Preá and all inbound logistics
  4. Coordinates last‑mile delivery into Jericoacoara with specialized 4x4/off‑road vehicles
  5. Oversees inventory accuracy, documentation, dispatch & receiving
  6. Plans and supervises loading/unloading, equipment rental, and batch delivery scheduling
  7. Works closely with Construction for delivery timelines, site readiness, and installation planning
  8. Supervises Utopia‑hired installers to ensure deadlines, quality standards, and contractual commitments
  9. Must be highly organized, proactive, and experienced in complex or remote logistics environments

Responsibilities

Production Oversight & Quality Control

  • Supervise FF&E production at each factory (Brazil & Europe).
  • Conduct detailed quality checks and approve inventory before packing and sign‑off.
  • Ensure all items meet Utopia’s standards for quality, specifications, and finishes.

Inbound Logistics & Storage Management

  • Monitor and confirm the arrival of goods at the Preá storage facility.
  • Arrange and oversee loading/unloading operations at all locations.
  • Hire necessary local equipment or machinery as required.
  • Maintain a full, accurate, and continuously updated inventory of all items.

Documentation & Compliance

  • Handle all dispatch, receiving, and transport paperwork.
  • Ensure complete documentation for internal controls and auditing.

Delivery Coordination & Final‑Mile Logistics

  • Oversee delivery schedules from factories to Preá, ensuring timely arrivals.
  • Plan and manage logistics from Preá to Jericoacoara—including batch deliveries due to access restrictions (large trucks cannot cross dunes).
  • Hire and coordinate appropriate 4x4 or off‑road trucks capable of operating in sandy conditions.
  • Supervise all loading/unloading operations for the Preá–Jericoacoara transfers.

On‑Site Coordination & Installation Support

  • Coordinate delivery timelines and equipment needs with the Construction team.
  • Organize and supervise unpacking activities.
  • Oversee Utopia‑hired installation teams to ensure full compliance with contract requirements, deadlines, and quality standards.

Professional Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in FF&E logistics, supply chain management, project management, or procurement—preferably in hospitality or high‑end residential projects.
  • Proven experience supervising factory production, performing quality checks, and managing sign‑off processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate international and domestic logistics (Brazil + Europe preferred).
  • Experience managing storage facilities, inventory systems, and warehouse operations.
  • Solid track record overseeing loading/unloading operations, equipment rental, and transport coordination.
  • Hands‑on experience with remote or difficult‑access job sites (desert, beach, island, jungle environments are a strong plus).
  • Experience coordinating with construction teams, installers, and multiple vendors simultaneously.
  • Prior responsibility for delivery scheduling, documentation, and compliance.
  • Experience supervising installation teams is highly desirable.
  • Portuguese and English a must - any other language a plus.

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of FF&E manufacturing processes, materials, finishes, and quality standards.
  • Proficiency in inventory management tools, tracking systems, and documentation workflows.
  • Understanding of logistics planning, especially final‑mile or off‑road delivery constraints.
  • Familiarity with transport regulations, customs basics, and dispatch/receiving procedures.
  • Strong reporting and documentation skills (photos, checklists, receiving logs, QC reports).
  • Ability to read technical documents (spec sheets, shop drawings, BOQs).

Salary and benefits are competitive and based on candidate experience.

Position Title: Senior Operations Associate
About The Role
S&P Global Energy (SPGE) is seeking a dynamic, collaborative, and knowledgeable candidate to fill the role of Senior Operations Associate, based in Brazil or Mexico.
Reporting to the Head of Legal, Strategy & Operations, this individual will provide valuable support to various aspects of the Team’s operational work, and will assist our user community by providing guidance on the tools used by the legal department such as Ironclad CLM, DocuSign eSignature, MS Office, SharePoint, and Teams.
The selected candidate should strive for continuous service improvement and provide efficient and effective support to end users. They should display sound judgment when making decisions and demonstrate initiative when a situation calls for action. The candidate will help to drive adoption of our operational systems and processes, while providing world-class support and service to our user community.
Responsibilities

  • Manage legal systems such as Ironclad CLM, DocuSign eSignature, Appian, Microsoft tools such as SharePoint, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, AI tools etc.
  • Assisting with the knowledge management repository, including filing and document storage.
  • Provide operations support to a global cross-functional user community, respond to incoming service requests in a timely manner.
  • Analyse and resolve problems associated with the CLM including agreement generation, workflow routing, and digital signature requests.
  • Project management of allocated projects, including IT projects to drive implementation.
  • Assist users with Ironclad reporting functionality, develop internal and customer reports.
  • Perform agreement governance, inventory, and manage controls.
  • Assist in development, documentation, and implementation of standard operating procedures and customer service guidelines.
  • Document all actions performed to resolve issues, keep knowledge base of known issues, and develop solutions.
  • Manage legal team meeting schedules, agenda and minutes.
  • Provide training as needed to SPGE's Legal and Business teams on the CLM and other technology and AI tools.
  • Assisting the legal team in designing PowerPoint presentation decks.
  • Managing and monitoring legal team general mailboxes and other matters as assigned by the Head of Legal, Strategy & Operations

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field.

  • Knowledge of Ironclad CLM, DocuSign eSignature, Appian, and Salesforce.

  • Good understanding of content life cycle management tools, task automation workflows, document generation and other information management tools.
  • Strong stakeholder management and business relationship skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate at all levels of the organization.
  • Strong project management skills.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Strong team player who works well with others but is also able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Proven track record of using automation tools and development expertise to create and deliver time and effort saving efficiencies in support of End User Services.
Return To Work
Have you taken time out for caring responsibilities and are now looking to return to work? As part of our Return to Work initiative, Restart, we are encouraging enthusiastic and talented returners to apply, and will actively support your return to the workplace.

Advancing Essential Intelligence.

We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Responsabilidades e Atribuições

Obrigatório:

Formação Superior completo em Engenharia.

Conhecimentos | Habilidades | Experiência:
  • Experiência operacional em Medição e Apropriação de Fluidos.

  • Vivência com as atividades relacionadas à Consolidação e Validação dos Volumes de Produção (Boletins diários e mensais) e no carregamento de informações de produção em formato XML.

Mission Overview

The Regional C&B Partner, LATAM, will lead the Compensation & Benefits strategy for Latin America, ensuring internal equity, external competitiveness, and support for business transformation, while maintaining consistency with global practices, adapting to local needs, and maintaining an employee value proposition that remains consistent and attractive across Latin America.

The Regional C&B Partner, LATAM, will report to the Sr. Director, Human Resources - Latin America.

Key Responsibilities

  • Market Trend Monitoring
    • Stay updated on compensation and benefits practices in the region to maintain competitiveness.
    • Conduct and analyze external compensation surveys and market trends to develop innovative compensation initiatives and manage cyclical activities such as open enrollment
  • Bridge Between Global and Regional Teams and Business Leaders
    • Act as a liaison between the global compensation team and regional leaders, translating business needs into appropriate policies and programs.
    • Partner with managers to define compensation packages that ensure internal equity and external competitiveness.
    • Train HRBPs and leaders on C&B practices, career ranges, and JA as a tool for dialogue and development.
    • Support Transformation Projects in the region (integrations, restructures, new businesses), ensuring pay/benefits structures enable change.

    • Ensure accurate and timely data for salary reviews, inflation, offers, benefits, and structural adjustments.
    • Support or coordinate the region’s participation in market surveys according to local practices.
    • Perform comprehensive audits to verify the accuracy, compliance, and integrity of compensation practices and data within the system of record
    • Ensure adherence to Job Architecture (families, streams, levels, profiles) as the foundation for pay structures, career paths, and communication.
    • Conduct ad-hoc reviews (turnover due to pay, attraction challenges, organizational changes) and recommend market positioning adjustments.
  • Benefits & Total Rewards
    • Map, benchmark, and optimize benefits packages (health, life, meal, transportation, mobility, wellness, retirement), balancing harmonization and local customization across Latin America.
    • Manage vendors and administrators (negotiation, SLAs, quality, employee experience) and lead flex benefits projects
  • Policy Communication and Implementation
    • Guarantee that global, regional, and Local policies are communicated and applied correctly, including merit cycles, inflation, benefits, promotions, and incentive programs.
    • Implement and develop Regional policies aligned with global practices.
    • Reviewed and validated the local policies, ensuring that they are aligned with the Global policies and strategies.
  • Support Global Compensation Philosophy
    • Contribute to the execution of global strategies, including short- and long-term incentive programs, equity plans, and process governance .
    • Lead the design and end-to-end management of compensation programs, including salary adjustments, inflation, bonuses, and rewards, benefits ensuring strategic alignment and compliance.

Studies & Experiences

  • Degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Psychology, or related; MBA/post-grad preferred.
  • Expected 8–12+ years in Compensation & Benefits/Total Rewards, with multi-country LATAM exposure.
  • Expertise in Job Architecture, job evaluation/levelling, and market pricing with global providers.
  • Experience in managing pay structures, incentives (STI/LTI), mobility, benefits, and compensation analytics, and tools and benchmarks (Mercer, WTW, CompAnalyst), Excel/BI, HRIS/ERP systems.

Soft Skills

  • Ability to work in a matrix environment with cross-cultural flexibility ;

Main responsibilities

O profissional de vendas desempenha um papel crucial na condução e apoio aos distribuidores da Tirolez, garantindo que os produtos sejam distribuídos de maneira eficiente, garantindo o atingimento das metas propostas de acordo com a estratégia da Cia., este cargo envolve uma combinação de gestão de relacionamento, análise de mercado e implementação de estratégias comerciais.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Interface Principal: Atuar como a principal interface entre a Tirolez e os distribuidores, garantindo a comunicação eficaz e a implementação das estratégias da empresa.
  • Expansão de Mercado: Identificar e desenvolver novas oportunidades de mercado para os produtos da Cia.
  • Planejamento Estratégico: Desenvolver e implementar planos estratégicos para aumentar a participação de mercado e a penetração dos produtos nos canais de distribuição.
  • Negociação de Acordos Comerciais: Negociar termos e condições com distribuidores, assegurando acordos que beneficiem ambas as partes e promovam o crescimento das vendas.
  • Elaboração e Gestão do JBP: Criar e gerenciar o Joint Business Plan (JBP), alinhando os objetivos do distribuidor com as metas da Tirolez.
  • Gestão de Contas Prioritárias: Focar na gestão de contas prioritárias, como supermercados e demais lojas do canal, bem como os clientes do canal Food Service, para garantir a visibilidade e a disponibilidade dos produtos.
  • Desenvolvimento de Campanhas: Planejar e executar campanhas promocionais e estruturais para aumentar a demanda dos produtos.
  • Análise de Eficácia: Monitorar e analisar a eficácia das campanhas promocionais, ajustando as estratégias conforme necessário para maximizar os resultados.
  • Coordenação de Atividades: Coordenar todas as atividades relacionadas à gestão do cliente, garantindo que as estratégias da Tirolez sejam executadas de forma eficaz pelos distribuidores.
  • Liderança de Discussões: Liderar discussões sobre nível de serviço, merchandising e novas oportunidades de mercado, promovendo a colaboração entre a Tirolez e os distribuidores.
  • Desenvolvimento de Equipes: Atuar como consultor no desenvolvimento das equipes de vendas dos distribuidores, oferecendo treinamento e suporte contínuo.
  • Capacitação de Líderes: Treinar supervisores, gerentes, vendedores e entregadores, desenvolvendo suas habilidades e conhecimentos para melhorar o desempenho geral.
  • Monitoramento de KPIs: Monitorar indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs) relacionados à produtividade, custos, rentabilidade e nível de serviço.
  • Análise de Dados: Analisar dados de vendas e desempenho para identificar tendências e oportunidades de melhoria para o desenvolvimento da região.
  • Garantia de Qualidade: Representar a Tirolez em visitas aos distribuidores para garantir que os padrões de qualidade e segurança sejam mantidos.
  • Treinamento em Qualidade: Oferecer treinamento em qualidade e segurança para todas as áreas do distribuidor, assegurando a conformidade com as normas da Tirolez.
  • Reuniões Regulares: Realizar reuniões regulares de trabalho e resultados com os distribuidores, alinhando expectativas e elaborando planos de ação.
  • Influência Estratégica: Influenciar a estruturação do negócio do distribuidor com base nas diretrizes estratégicas da Tirolez, promovendo melhores práticas e eficiência operacional.

Requirements and skills

  • Formação Acadêmica: Administração de empresas ou áreas correlatas; certificação em vendas ou marketing será um diferencial;
  • Experiência: Vivência com vendas, vivência com clientes de médio e grande porte.
  • Conhecimentos/Habilidades: Informática (MS Office), Ferramenta de Dados (Mtrix, Scanntech, etc).

Competências Comportamentais:

  • Capacidade de negociação, persuasão e resolução de conflitos,
  • Proativo com foco em resultados e gestão de prioridades, alta capacidade analítica e tomada de decisão estratégica,
  • Ter perfil Hunter para prospecção de novos parceiros.

Our UCM Data team builds, enhances, and maintains the data that underpins Wood Mackenzie’s unique understanding of the energy and natural resources sectors. Data is the key driver behind Wood Mackenzie’s mission to transform the way we power the planet.

Join the team to analyze critical oil and gas industry data, focusing on data management, pipeline development, and quality assurance challenges while collaborating across Data, Research, and Product teams.

  • Strong communication skills

At Wood Mackenzie, you will have opportunities to engage in meaningful work and collaboration with international stakeholders, creating a positive and lasting impact, and find the support, coaching, and training you need to kick‑start your career.

In this role, you will get the following:

We are committed to supporting our people to Thrive. We value different perspectives and aspire to create an inclusive environment that encourages diversity and fosters a sense of belonging. Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, working alongside FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (“FWWC2027”).

The Position

The overall purpose of the Insurance Manager is to ensure the efficient implementation and supervision of insurance coverage according to FIFA requirements. The Insurance Manager will also serve as the local contact for Insurance Brokers.

  • Identify and evaluate potential risks, proposing countermeasures.
  • Support the implementation of a local risk management program.

Your Profile

title: QUALITY CONTROL ANALYST - 2ND SHIFT Job Details | Laboratoire Guerbet
description:
At Guerbet, we build lasting relationships so that to enable people to live better. This is Our Purpose.

We are a global leader in medical imaging, offering an extensive portfolio of pharmaceuticals, medical devices, digital and AI solutions, for diagnostic and interventional imaging. As a pioneer in the field of contrast products since the last 100 years, we continuously innovate to improve the diagnosis, prognosis and quality of life of patients.

Customer Centricity, Cooperation, Audacity, Focus, and Responsibility are the values that we share and practice on a daily basis.

Working at Guerbet is not only being part of a multicultural team with nearly 3,000 people across more than 20 countries, but it is above all about playing a unique role in the future of medical imaging.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

This person will actively participate in the company's Quality System to ensure that the physical and chemical analysis procedure is carried out on production materials, enabling the product to meet the required quality standards. This is a second shift position.

YOUR ROLE

  • Analysis of in-process product, finished product and raw material
  • Perform sample preparation, execute and interpret high performance liquic chromatography (HPLC) analyse using Empower systems
  • Control the use and useful life of hPLC columns
  • Perform sample preparation, perform and interpret anayses using absorption spectrophotometry.
  • Perform sample preparation, execute and interpret titrimetry analyses in automatic titrators.
  • Sample identification by infrared
  • Review operational procedures
  • Develop procedures for new equipment
  • Record analytical results in the LIMS system
  • Perform/record opt of speculation (OOS) investigation
  • Understand, comply with, and respect HSE (Safety, Health, and Environment) procedures, instructions, and rules as part of your daily roleand responsibilities, acting to ensure your own safety and contribute to the safety of others, always adopting safe behavior.
  • Exercise yourcommitment to HSE by participating in safety, health, and environment training and initiatives, and continually practice risk awareness inyour daily work.

YOUR BACKGROUND

  • Experience in quality control, with good technical knowledge for analysis of in-process product, finished
    product, imported product and HPLC methods.
  • Degree in pharmacy or chemestry
  • Experience in pharmaceutical
  • Operational knowledge of liquid chromatography
  • GMP Good Laboratory Practices
  • Knowledge of European regulations related to the anaysis routine.

WHY JOIN US

We offer continued personal development. When you join Guerbet, you:

  • Are choosing a global leader with recognized expertise in diagnostic and interventional imaging,
  • Are joining our 3000 collaborators who are committed every day to offering innovative solutions to improve quality of patient’s life all over the world,
  • Are joining a company where we value diversity of talents coming from various horizons.

Do you want to help improve patients’ lives with us?
We look forward to meeting you and continuing our story together!

Open source software is the new default in the enterprise, and Canonical is the new challenger to major enterprise software vendors.
We deliver better open source from the data center to cloud and edge. Our Linux distribution Ubuntu is now the leading platform for public cloud compute, and the favorite platform for software engineers, data scientists and AI developers. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption and quality of open source globally, and our goal is to ship the most software on the planet by cores. A tidal wave of open source innovation is the next phase of the entire enterprise software industry, and we aim to be the most compelling way to ride that wave.
Our customers include Global 500 enterprises and startups. We are expanding our product range from the base operating system - Ubuntu - to full enterprise solutions in infrastructure and applications. We can deliver software defined storage, private cloud solutions, container runtime environments, as well as databases, message queues, identity, observability, analytics, machine learning and web publishing capabilities. Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application.
Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are just over 1,000 colleagues in 70+ countries and $250m in revenue, profitable, on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.
We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position, it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world leading company we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment which promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.
In building our sales team, we look for five things:

  • Empathy for the customer - a real understanding of customer needs, industry-specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems
  • High intellect - the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence
  • Passion for technology - a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes
  • Teamwork - a willingness to help others, to collaborate well with people from different disciplines, and to balance personal and team ambitions
  • Energy - the drive to motivate oneself and others to achieve the best result for the team and our customers
Ubuntu is already very widely adopted which gives us a credible basis for conversations in the market. Nevertheless, it requires real work for sales professionals to build on that adoption to create trusted and profitable commercial relationships with the enterprises in their territory. Our product managers and marketing teams run campaigns to generate awareness, engagement and leads, but you will need to go beyond managing inbound interest to develop the potential of your territory. You will need judgement as to which industries and companies are ready to go deeper with open source and Canonical, and energy to develop relationships in advance of proven interest. We expect professional practice, territory and account planning, as well as clear, complete and continuous reporting on pipeline status and activity, using standard professional tools.
The successful candidate will carry an annual bookings quota within their assigned territory. They should be able to travel regionally for client engagement, industry conferences, and internationally for company events twice a year. They will be expected to demonstrate professionalism and effectiveness, to prospect accounts for new business, maintain and develop existing relationships, and work with colleagues and partners on account strategy. They must be comfortable selling enterprise software, open source, cloud, virtualization, container technologies and technical software solutions to senior levels of the enterprise.
Location: We are expanding our sales organisation globally and have open roles in every region.
What your day will look like
  • Represent the company, its solutions and software, in your territory
  • Build and execute a territory plan to prioritize outreach and prospecting
  • Develop new pipeline through outreach, prospecting, local marketing, and industry events
  • Close contracts to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets
  • Be mindful and proactive in achieving tactical and strategic objectives
  • Manage customer relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales cycle
  • Work with field engineers to propose solutions that solve our customers' business problems
  • Work with customer success to identify growth opportunities
  • Maintain accurate pipeline data and forecasts within Salesforce
  • Establish productive professional relationships with key influencers and decision makers
What we are looking for in you
  • Bachelor's level degree, preferably in engineering or computer science
  • Experience of open source technology and solutions
  • Detail oriented with effective follow-up
  • Experience in enterprise software or technology sales planning and execution
  • Track record of achievement in sales targets and new account wins
  • Self-discipline and motivation to be successful in a distributed team
  • Professional written and spoken English, as well as any language that may be appropriate for your target market
  • Ability to travel for customer engagements, industry events and company events
Additional Skills Of Interest
  • Specific vertical experience, in particular finance, telco, health, energy, public sector, tech
  • Experience speaking at conferences or industry events
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance when shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven commission structure. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a fully distributed company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

-Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;

>-Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;

-Acesse nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!

-Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

  • Build and maintain test harnesses for RESTful APIs, data streams, and web services.

Education and Background

Technical Skills

  • Exposure to AWS environments (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, ECS/EKS) is a plus.
  • Comfortable working in Linux and Windows environments.
  • Knowledge of Git, GitHub Actions, or similar CI/CD tools.

Soft Skills

Success Metrics

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades.

Responsabilidades

  • Atuará em rotina externa para prospectar novos clientes na rota do polo.
  • Gerenciar a carteira de clientes ativos e de pós-venda.
  • Participar das matinais diárias do time para traçar os seus planos, metas e trocas de aprendizados.
  • Entregar um atendimento de excelência ao nosso cliente.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo
  • Desejável experiência prévia em vendas externas no setor de adquirência ou serviços financeiros.
  • Habilidade em negociação e abordagem comercial
  • Trabalhar de forma orientada a resultados e metas

Benefícios

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico
  • Hospital Virtual Verde disponível 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana, de forma rápida e prática
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação - Pluxee

  • Benefício Educação - Plataforma interna com acesso a diversos livros, podcasts, treinamentos e videoaulas visando o autodesenvolvimento (Studa e Biblioteca StoneCo)

Nossa Cultura

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

  • Own It: Espírito de dono traz liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo que entregamos e buscamos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.
  • Live the Ride: Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com erros e vemos desafios como oportunidades de crescimento.
  • No Bullshit: Agimos com simplicidade. Somos práticos, sinceros e valorizamos feedbacks, usando transparência para evoluir, mesmo em erros.
  • Team Play: Quer ir rápido? Vá sozinho(a). Quer ir longe? Vá em equipe. Aprendemos uns com os outros, e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.
  • The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos impactá-lo positivamente e ver as melhorias que trazemos à sua vida.

E aí? Curtiu? Então, não deixa de se inscrever e #VemSerStone

title: Comprador
description:
O que você irá fazer

  • Analisar e realizar negociações pequena/média e alta complexidade, monitoramento de mercado e oportunidades, visando às melhores condições de custo, qualidade, serviço e entrega.
  • Receber e analisar as solicitações de compras enviadas geradas via sistema, atentando para o tipo de mercadoria, quantidade requerida, qualidade exigida e grau de necessidade, priorizando o atendimento e respeitando prazos pré-estabelecidos.
  • Atualizar cadastro e acompanhar o desempenho de novos fornecedores, no que tange ao desenvolvimento de fornecimento e estrutura organizacional, de modo a assegurar as condições comerciais a serem estabelecidas.
  • Efetuar negociações de compras diversas, materiais, serviços, atentando para as melhores condições oferecidas.
  • Manter os Fornecedores atualizados, quanto às normas e procedimentos preestabelecidos, orientá-los sobre as necessidades e exigências do grupo, tais como: horário para recebimento de mercadorias, nível de qualidade dos produtos e outros, solicitar ações corretivas, quando necessário.
  • Desenvolver fornecedores, prospectar várias fontes alternativas, verificando aquelas que melhor atendam as necessidades e garantam o abastecimento da Empresa.
  • Atender e realizar outras atividades profissionais correlatas e inerentes ao cargo, conforme orientação e solicitação do Gestor imediato.
  • Emitir relatórios mensais conforme solicitado pelo Gestor.

O que você precisa ter

  • Compras do improdutivo e cotações, contato com fornecedores
  • Experiência em indústria com processos de compras improdutivas;
  • Superior cursando ou concluído em Administração de Empresas, Economia, Logística ou Áreas Correlatas;
  • Experiência em compras, almoxarifado, recebimento de mercadorias;
  • Conhecimentos básicos de custos de materiais e matéria prima;
  • Conhecimentos básicos em negociação com fornecedores;
  • Analítico, sendo responsável por mapeamento de processos e indicadores da área, identificar a causa raiz das falhas no processo;
  • Conhecimentos básicos em movimentação de materiais em estoque.

Observações

  • Atuação Presencial no bairro Galeão.
  • Horário: Segunda a sexta das 08h as 18h e sexta 08h as 17h.
  • Vale alimentação;
  • Refeição no local; Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Seguro de vida em grupo;

title: Scrum Master Pleno
description:
Vaga: Scrum Master Pleno

Sobre a oportunidade

Estamos em busca de um(a) Scrum Master Pleno para atuar com nossas equipes ágeis, garantindo a aplicação das práticas do framework Scrum e promovendo a melhoria contínua dos processos. Procuramos alguém com experiência prática em agilidade, boa capacidade de facilitação e comunicação, que ajude a fortalecer a colaboração entre times e stakeholders.

Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir as cerimônias do Scrum (daily, planning, review e retrospective).
  • Apoiar o Product Owner na organização e priorização do backlog.
  • Identificar e remover impedimentos do time.
  • Garantir que os princípios e valores ágeis sejam aplicados no dia a dia.
  • Acompanhar métricas ágeis e apoiar a melhoria contínua.
  • Promover um ambiente colaborativo e de alto desempenho.

Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada como Scrum Master em nível pleno.
  • Conhecimento sólido em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, etc.).
  • Habilidade de facilitação, comunicação e resolução de conflitos.
  • Vivência em times de tecnologia/produtos digitais.
  • Certificação em Scrum (PSM I, CSM ou equivalente).

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em projetos de transformação ágil.
  • Conhecimento em métricas e ferramentas de acompanhamento ágil.
  • Certificações adicionais em agilidade (KMP, SAFe, PMI-ACP).

O que oferecemos

  • Day - off de aniversário
  • Cultura voltada para inovação, colaboração e aprendizado contínuo.
  • Oportunidade de crescimento profissional em um ambiente ágil.

description:
Sr. Technology Value Realization Specialist (Relocation to Saudi Arabia required)

Join to apply for the Sr. Technology Value Realization Specialist (Relocation to Saudi Arabia required) role at aramco

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Overview

We are seeking a Technology Value Realization Specialist to join our Technology Strategy & Planning Department (TSPD). TSPD’s mission is to provide high-impact leadership and support across the technology life‑cycle, from strategy setting to value realization and sustainable growth, and partner with corporate and business stakeholders to integrate new technologies into the company’s strategies and investment plans.

Your primary role is to play a central part in the corporate stage‑gate and value realization process. You will provide leadership in the implementation, governance and sustainable capability needed to support full integration, application and continuous improvement of the technology stage‑gate process.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the company-wide roll‑out of the Technology Realized Value (TRV) KPI validation and reporting process in partnership with Upstream, Downstream, Finance & Technology Organizations.
  • Manage and oversee the technology stage‑gate process, including ongoing implementation to support R&D, technology development, demonstration and deployment, and transition to operations in order to enable value realization from technology investments.
  • Provide leadership for scientists, engineers, and other business/functional specialists to enable de‑risking and go/no‑go decisions for R&D projects, ensuring technical‑commercial readiness prior to deployment and value realization.
  • Serve as an internal consultant for project teams on the development of robust business cases, deployment and value realization strategies, including partnering with technical, commercial and business leads to implement robust commercial review process to maximize financial return and strategic impact from R&D projects.
  • Assess technology stage‑gate practices and related activities across the Company, in order to maintain high‑standards and compliance with the Corporate Technology Development General Instructions.
  • Partner with R&D staff and stakeholders in technology, business and supporting functions, in order to ensure alignment across all areas and to support a smooth transition and adoption of the enhanced technology management processes.
  • Provide expert guidance to project teams and technology/executive management on related activities, including business case development, IP and commercial strategy, supply chain development, deployment plans, business models, value realization and related techno‑economics.
  • Support financial reporting for deployed technologies to ensure value capture.

Qualifications

  • You must hold a Bachelor degree in Science or Engineering. An advanced degree (MBA/Finance) is highly desirable.
  • You should have at least 10 years of professional experience, including at least 5 years of experience in commercial technology development and value realization, preferably with some experience in oil and gas, chemicals and related industries.
  • You must possess subject matter expertise, business acumen and effective change management skills.
  • You will be able to demonstrate experience with Project and Portfolio Management (PPM) systems, such as Planisware, Accolade, Clarity and similar software applications.
  • A proven track record of successfully working with multi‑cultural, cross‑functional teams, and developing productive working relationships.
  • Experience with Operation Excellence (OE) process development, implementation, including continuous improvement is also required.Advanced writing and verbal skills in English. Resumes must be submitted in English.

Mid‑Senior level

Full‑time

Industries

Energy Technology, Oil and Gas, and Chemical Manufacturing

Operational Discipline Requirements

HSE Requirements

    • Assist in running and cementing casing strings, running and retrieving BOPs and risers, and other operations as directed by the Driller or Toolpusher.
    • Monitor mud systems and supervise solids control equipment and mud mixing operation.
    • Assist in the planning, organization and execution of rig move operations.
    • Operate drilling and associated equipment as directed by the Driller, i.e. Top Drive System, mud pumps, BOP and Diverter controls, etc.
    • Know the clients’ rules and Company procedures for well control and blowout prevention.
    • Incorporate the THINK process into all tasks, whether working alone or as part of a team.
    • Participate daily in START process.
    • Ensure subordinate personnel are properly trained in the START process.
    • Call a Time Out for Safety (TOFS) whenever an unplanned hazard or a change in the expected results is observed.
    • Ensure all relevant safety procedures and practices are adhered to during drilling operations, in accordance to the Company QHSE manual.
    • Report any incidents, potential hazards or abnormal situations to the Driller or Toolpusher.
    • Actively participate in weekly safety meetings and pre-tour meetings as required, FOCUS Improvement Process, and all other Company safety management systems.
    • Assist in conducting drilling operations safety drills as and when required.
    • Demonstrate commitment to the Company’s safety policies through leadership and guidance.

    • Meet the training requirements according to the applicable training matrix.

title: Retail Credit Risk Specialist
description:
About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building.

Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human.

Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page

About the team

The Credit Risk Squad is part of the 2nd line of Defense, responsible for managing and overseeing the credit risk function of our organization by providing independent oversight and challenge to the first line of defense. As a second line Credit Risk team, we are responsible for creating Expected Credit Losses (ECL) models that are used to calculate loss allowances, making sure the company’s credit risk is managed correctly and efficiently, participating end-to-end in the model development process, including, implementation,monitoring, ensuring operational quality of the data and supporting Finance accounting teams.

About the Role

As a Credit Risk Specialist within our Credit Risk Squad (part of the 2nd Line of Defense), you will play a crucial role in supporting Nubank’s world class risk management framework. Your primary focus will be on expected credit loss models development and maintenance, particularly within the retail market portfolios, including credit cards and personal loans. You will contribute significantly to ensuring the company’s credit risk is managed effectively, with a strong emphasis on the universe of credit provisions.

Responsibilities

  • Developing, implementing, analysing and monitoring risk parameter models (PD, LGD, EAD) relevant to our retail portfolios, ensuring they align with regulations like IFRS9 and 4966. You will be instrumental in making sure we have state of the art models also through activities such as backtesting, data analysis, documentation and operational monitoring.
  • Maintaining a strong understanding of relevant local and international regulations concerning provisions and credit risk management, including a surface-level understanding of standards like Bacen 4966 and IFRS9.
  • Performing in-depth analysis of credit risk exposure and its implications for expected credit losses (ECL) and loss allowances. This will involve understanding how changes in the credit portfolio impact our provisions.
  • Participating in monthly accounting closing activities, contributing to the creation of reports on loss allowance movements.
  • Actively contributing to the enhancement of our controls environment within credit risk management. This is crucial for ensuring compliance with regulations such as SOX.
  • Liaising with Internal and External Audit teams during model validation processes, ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements and SOX compliance in our operational processes.
  • Leveraging your analytical and problem-solving skills to manipulate and learn from data related to the credit portfolio.
  • This role requires a strong analytical background, a keen understanding of credit risk principles, and the ability to contribute to a robust and compliant credit risk management framework. Your work will directly impact the accuracy of our financial reporting and the overall stability of our credit operations.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Economics, Math, Statistics, Physics or related fields
  • Analytical, problem solving and passionate to manipulate data in order to learn from it
  • Great coding skills (SQL, Python, Scala or other similar programming languages)
  • Experience in developing or analyzing outputs of Expected Credit Loss models/PD/EAD/LGD for credit provisioning purposes
  • Adaptability to dynamic way of working/short term deliverables

Preferred qualifications

  • Advanced or Fluent English
  • Experience with SOX controls within risk management environment

Buscamos pessoas comunicativas, determinadas, que gostem de gente e tenham ambição de crescer junto com uma das maiores joalherias do país .

Para vaga, procuramos pessoas com forte visão de negócio, senso estético e perfil analítico para atuar de forma estratégica na gestão do portfólio de produtos. Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Gestão do portfólio de produtos: acompanhar o desempenho comercial e de margem, propondo ações de mix, descontinuação ou ajustes de preço.
  • Análise de mercado e concorrência: monitorar tendências, lançamentos e posicionamento competitivo, gerando insights para decisões de sortimento e inovação.
  • Cadastro de produtos no sistema: garantir a correta inserção e atualização de informações técnicas e comerciais, incluindo descrições, medidas, custos, composição e dados para o site.
  • Gestão de pedidos de compra: emitir pedidos, acompanhar aprovações, controlar envios e atuar em interface com o time de supply chain para assegurar entregas dentro do prazo e dentro da verba de compra planejada.
  • Negociação com fornecedores: buscar continuamente os melhores custos, prazos e condições comerciais, mantendo o equilíbrio entre qualidade, rentabilidade e posicionamento de marca.
  • Desenvolvimento de novos produtos: atuar em conjunto com os times de criação, marketing e comercial para garantir que novos produtos sejam relevantes, rentáveis e entreguem a qualidade esperada.
  • Planejamento de lançamentos: definir estratégias de entrada no mercado, pricing, metas de vendas e posicionamento junto ao time de marketing e comercial.
  • Gestão de indicadores: acompanhar KPIs, margem, giro e cobertura de estoque, elaborando planos de ação quando necessário.
  • Suporte ao demais times: fazer interface constante com times de marketing, supply, comercial, e-commerce e visual merchandising, garantindo coerência e execução das estratégias de produto.
  • Apoio à liderança: contribuir com análises estratégicas para suportar decisões de negócio e de produtos.
  • Gestão do ciclo de vida: propor ações para maximizar o desempenho de cada produto desde o lançamento até o eventual encerramento.

The Role

We're seeking a bold, strategic UX Designer who blends creativity, analytical rigor, and a growth mindset. This is not a simple UI design role; it is for a thinker‑doer who wants to shape how millions of users engage, share, and monetize across our products.

You’ll design and optimize user experiences that drive engagement, retention, and revenue, starting with Mode's new social app, and expanding across Mode's broader portfolio. You’ll work at the intersection of design, product, data, and monetization, turning insights into elegant, high‑impact experiences that fuel growth loops and business outcomes.

  • Thorough: Produce thoughtful, impactful, accurate, and complete work with meticulous detail.

Workplace Norms

  • Accomplish more with less.
  • Hold yourself & others to high standards.

title: SEO Content Writer
description:
Join to apply for the SEO Content Writer role at Ottomatik.io

Hi there! We are South, and our client is looking for an SEO Content Writer!

Note to Applicants

  • Eligibility: This position is open to candidates residing in Latin America.
  • Application Language: Please submit your CV in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.
  • Professional Presentation: We encourage you to showcase your professional experience by including a Loom video in the application form. While this is optional, candidates who provide a video presentation will be given priority.

About the Company

Our client is a fast‑growing digital marketing agency specializing in SEO, content strategy, and organic growth. They partner with brands across SaaS, e‑commerce, tech, and professional services, helping them scale their online presence through high‑impact, data‑driven content.

The agency values creativity, innovation, and a modern content production workflow that blends AI efficiency with human craftsmanship to deliver top‑tier SEO performance.

About the Role

We are looking for a skilled SEO Content Writer to create high‑quality, search‑optimized content across multiple client campaigns. This is a full‑time, remote role for someone who knows how to use AI tools for drafting—but relies on excellent human editing skills to ensure all final content is original, accurate, engaging, and aligned with brand voice.

You will collaborate with SEO strategists to produce blog posts, guides, landing pages, and long‑form resources designed to increase organic traffic, rankings, and conversions. Success in this role comes from strong research ability, mastery of on‑page SEO, exceptional editing skills, and the capacity to manage multiple deadlines within a fast‑paced agency environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Content Creation & Editing
    • Research topics and generate initial content drafts using AI tools, refining them with deep human edits for originality, accuracy, tone, and SEO alignment.
    • Produce SEO‑optimized content that naturally incorporates primary and long‑tail keywords, metadata, internal linking, and other on‑page best practices.
    • Adapt AI‑generated drafts to match the client brand voice, audience needs, and industry context.
  • SEO Optimization & Performance
    • Analyze performance data (via tools like Google Analytics, Ahrefs, or SEMrush) and iterate on content to improve rankings and engagement.
    • Review and elevate underperforming content through updated research, stronger messaging, and human‑edited enhancements.
    • Stay updated on SEO trends, algorithm updates, and AI advancements in content production.
  • Content Workflow Management
    • Manage content pipelines, including AI‑generated outlines, human editing, publishing within CMS platforms (WordPress), and coordinating internal/external approvals.
    • Ensure consistency, accuracy, and brand alignment across all written assets.
    • Collaborate with SEO strategists and creative teams to refine content direction and messaging.
  • Collaboration & Ideation
    • Participate in content brainstorming sessions and use AI tools for rapid ideation.
    • Suggest new topic opportunities based on keyword research and SERP trends.
    • Apply human curation to ensure all ideas are aligned with client goals and search intent.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in SEO content writing, preferably within an agency environment.
  • Demonstrated experience using AI tools for drafting (e.g., ChatGPT, Jasper, Claude) combined with strong human editing ability.
  • Solid understanding of SEO fundamentals, keyword research, content clustering, and on‑page optimization.
  • Experience publishing content in WordPress; Elementor knowledge is a plus.
  • Strong research skills and ability to translate AI‑generated information into polished, accurate, value‑driven content.
  • Familiarity with SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, or Google Keyword Planner.
  • Excellent written English with the ability to adapt tone and style across industries.

Preferred Skills

  • Understanding of technical SEO elements (schema, E‑E‑A‑T, etc.).
  • Experience writing for SaaS, e‑commerce, or tech clients.
  • Basic design abilities using tools like Canva for simple graphics.
  • Knowledge of content performance metrics and A/B content testing.
  • Ability to analyze AI vs. human‑edited outcomes to improve workflows.

Why Join Us?

  • Fully remote & flexible work environment.
  • Competitive salary in USD.
  • Opportunity to work with diverse clients and shape high‑impact SEO strategies.
  • Professional development in both AI‑assisted content creation and advanced SEO.
  • Collaborative environment that encourages creativity, autonomy, and continuous learning.
  • Send us your resume!

Referrals increase your chances of interviewing at Ottomatik.io by 2x.

Seniority level: Mid‑Senior level

Employment type: Full‑time

Job function: Marketing

Industries: Marketing Services

  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
