title: Software Engineer - Python and K8s
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. Our mission is to reinvent the way companies manage their open source information systems - on public clouds and in their own data centers. To achieve that we are building a new community around Python opscode for open source applications, running on Kubernetes. We want to move all of Canonical and Ubuntu IS onto this new, open source codebase. We are confident that we can dramatically improve the experience of running complex business operations - and then we can help our customers embrace those new techniques and products. Traditionally, IS is an inward-facing operation. We would like to transform our IS team into an extension of the product engineering capability at Canonical. Our internal workloads are in many cases the same open source workloads that our customers want to operate. This team will productize those workloads for real-time automated operations on Kubernetes. This role is ideal for software engineers who enjoy Python, have a passion for distributed systems, and an interest in the entire Linux stack - from kernel to networking to virtualization and containers. It is a role that requires rigor in both code and customer interactions. Our engineers are technically astute open source enthusiasts who are excited about cloud computing and are ready to join a global team charged with delivering world class services to our customers.

The role entails

  • Work in Python to design and deliver open source software operations code
  • Work across the entire Linux stack, from kernel, networking, storage, to applications
  • Learn to think rigorously about application and infrastructure reliability
  • Shape high quality open source monitoring and alerting infrastructure
  • Simplify open source operations for our customers and open source community
  • Demonstrate sound engineering design and testing principles in your code
  • Follow agile software development practices
  • Coach and develop your colleagues where you have insights
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with company values
  • Work from home with global travel once or twice a year for up to 2 weeks for events

What we are looking for in you

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You are experienced with Linux systems administration, package management, and operations
  • You have hands-on experience with at least one public cloud
  • You are familiar with Docker and Kubernetes
  • You are an experienced Python programmer and enjoy challenging projects
  • You understand the importance of reliable software and strive to design and code to that expectation
  • You are organized and want your team to deliver timely, high quality software

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
Join to apply for the Crew Analyst – Talent Attraction role at Maersk Supply Service

Join to apply for the Crew Analyst – Talent Attraction role at Maersk Supply Service

At Maersk Supply Service, we believe that crewing is more than logistics—it’s about people. We’re looking for a Crew Analyst who shares our commitment to openness, collaboration, respect and to build a trustful relationship with all stakeholders, especially our offshore colleagues. If you’re someone who values transparent communication and wants to make a meaningful impact on the lives of our offshore colleagues, we’d love to hear from you.

Who are we?

At Maersk Supply Service (MSS), we’re more than a marine solutions provider—we’re a team of people who genuinely care about doing things right. Based in Rio de Janeiro, you’ll be welcomed into a close-knit HR & Crewing team that thrives on collaboration, open dialogue, and mutual respect. You’ll work alongside colleagues from across the organisation, each bringing their own expertise to help us navigate the complexities of the energy sector with integrity, safety, and purpose.

We enjoy what we do! We have a flexible and energized work environment. Here, ideas are not just heard—they’re valued. We celebrate our diverse backgrounds and see them as a true source of strength. We work close together, humbling listening and learning from each other, and overcoming challenges together, “we” should come before “I”. Every day, we strive to create a supportive space where your voice matters and your contributions lead to real change. This role is a unique blend of operational excellence and human connection.

As a company, we are owned by A.P. Moller Holding, operating independently with the trust and empowerment to do what is right for us, while proudly bearing the Maersk name and values.

What You Will Be Doing

The crewing department includes several HR subsystems, and as a Crew Analyst – Talent Attraction – you’ll play a key role in shaping the future of our MSS operations.

You’ll drive alignment on talent attraction strategies and process along with the Crew Manager, will execute the talent attraction process, and build a sustainable pool of skilled professionals by leading our cadet programme—supporting the growth and development of new seafarers and helping them thrive in their maritime careers.

Who You Are

First and foremost, you are passionate about the maritime industry, talent attraction and enjoy building up trusted relationships, and you recognize the game-changing potential by working in crewing and the positive effect that you can bring to people’s life. In addition, we hope you can say yes to the following:

  • Proficiency in verbal and written English and Portuguese.
  • Bachelor’s degree in psychology, Administration or related areas.
  • MBA in Human Resource is preferable for this position.
  • 3 years of previous experience in similar roles. Previous roles in the Maritime industry would be an advantage.
  • Has a strategic mindset and understands how talent drives business success.
  • Build strong networks and knows how to attract top talent through authentic engagement.
  • Communicates with clarity and impact—whether crafting employer branding or engaging with candidates.
  • Makes quality decisions quickly and confidently, even in fast-paced environments.
  • Champions diversity and inclusion, valuing different perspectives and backgrounds.
  • Is customer-focused, always thinking about the candidate experience.
  • Thrives on collaboration, influencing stakeholders and aligning hiring needs across teams.
  • Operational Excellence: Strong attention to detail in managing crew data, cost control, and vessel planning, ensuring smooth and compliant operations.
  • Process Improvement & Quality Focus: Proactive in identifying opportunities to enhance procedures and energise the team through continuous improvement.

How to Apply

If you can imagine yourself in this role, we look very much forward to hearing from you. Please apply through our website no later than 12 September 2025. We will review and interview on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible.

Ready to make an impact? Bring your energy—let’s power a sustainable future together!

YOUR MISSIONS

The OT Cybersecurity Technical Architect is responsible for designing and implementing the technical components of the organization's cybersecurity strategy. This role involves creating secure systems and network architectures, selecting and configuring security technologies, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure the organization's digital assets are adequately protected.

  • Develop and implement OT cybersecurity architectures tailored for renewable energy production and operations.
  • Design secure and scalable network architectures for OT environments, including SCADA, ICS, and IoT systems.
  • Ensure OT security strategies align seamlessly with corporate IT and cybersecurity policies, while also adhering to industry standards, including IEC 62443 and ISO 27001.
  • Implement and supervise cybersecurity tools, including firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and vulnerability scanners, in OT environments.
  • Monitor and respond to OT security incidents, collaborating with incident response teams.
  • Collaborate with GRC team to address regulatory requirements.
  • Work closely with engineering, operations, and IT teams to integrate security into the lifecycle of OT assets.
  • Provide cybersecurity training and awareness programs for staff working with OT systems.
  • Engage with external vendors and partners to ensure secure deployment of third-party OT solutions.
  • Stay updated on emerging cybersecurity threats, trends, and technologies relevant to OT environments.
  • Develop and implement strategies for continuous improvement of OT cybersecurity posture.
  • Lead pilot projects and proof-of-concept initiatives for new cybersecurity technologies.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCES

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in cybersecurity, with at least 2 years focusing on OT environments (e.g., SCADA, ICS).
  • Deep knowledge of OT systems and protocols, including Modbus, DNP3, OPC, and MQTT.
  • Proficiency with cybersecurity frameworks like IEC 62443, NIST CSF, and MITRE ATT&CK for ICS.
  • Familiarity with firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, and endpoint protection in OT environments.
  • Strong understanding of networking principles (e.g., VLANs, VPNs, routing).
  • Experience in renewable energy or other critical infrastructure industries is a plus.
  • CISSP, GICSP, CISM, or equivalent certifications preferred.
  • Proficiency both in Portuguese and English.
  • Availiability for international travels.

KEY SKILLS

  • Strategic Vision-
  • Problem-Solving and organizational skills.
  • Strong ability to articulate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Proficiency in building relationships with internal and external partners to drive cybersecurity initiatives.
  • Resilient
  • Strong attention to detail to ensure precision in designing, implementing, and auditing cybersecurity measures.
  • Flexibility to respond to evolving cybersecurity threats and technological advancements.

Canonical is hiring a Python Software Engineer to join the Certification team, who make the tools which enable us to know that a desktop, laptop, server or IoT device is working properly. The Certification team develops the tools needed to certify hardware as working with Ubuntu Core as well as Ubuntu Desktop and Server: design hardware which can be used to probe devices independently, and frameworks for software tests that check every aspect of Ubuntu on that hardware.

We are looking for a self-motivated software engineer with experience developing in Python, to work on test automation tools or Linux based embedded hardware. This role offers an exciting opportunity to push the industry forward by enabling entirely new Linux based hardware testing capabilities, scaling up hardware certification efforts and allowing for deeper test coverage.
The role involves the development and maintenance of Canonical's open source certification tools, supporting the creation of hardware solutions for test automation, and automating our existing processes. We seek out continuous process and tooling improvements as part of expanding the certification test suites, ultimately to improve the quality of Linux experience felt by millions of Linux end users.
Key responsibilities

  • Maintain and develop new features to our Python based test automation tools like Checkbox, used by both in-house teams and industry partners.
  • Invent new ways to enable remote, automated testing.
  • Help build the software counterpart to in-house designed testing hardware to help test device enablement (graphics, hotplug, bluetooth, etc).
  • Write functional and performance tests to support hardware enablement and to protect from regressions.
  • Participate in meetings involving international travel 2-3 times per year.
Required Skills And Experience
  • Knowledge of Python programming language.
  • Quality oriented, pragmatic approach to software design and implementation.
  • Interest in test automation methodologies.
  • Previous experience working with Ubuntu or other Linux distributions.
  • Ability to be productive in a globally distributed team.
Desired Skills And Experience
  • Passion for tinkering: you are a maker.
  • Experience working in an agile environment.
  • Hardware testing experience, for example in the IoT space.
  • Familiarity with the C programming language.
What is Canonical?
Canonical is a growing international software company that works with the open-source community to deliver Ubuntu, "the world's best free software platform". Our services help businesses worldwide to reduce costs, improve efficiency and enhance security with Ubuntu.

title: Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho
description:
O Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho deve garantir a integridade física e a saúde dos colaboradores próprios e terceiros, a conformidade legal e a prevenção de acidentes nas operações de transportes e logística da DeLuna, promovendo uma cultura de segurança alinhada aos valores e metas ESG da empresa.

Requisitos

  • Curso Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho concluído. Registro/credenciamento profissional.
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos em operações de logística, armazenagem e transportes.
  • Conhecimentos técnicos:
    • NRs aplicáveis (NR-01, 04, 05, 06, 07, 10, 11, 12, 17, 20, 23, 26, 33, 35).
    • PGR, inventário de riscos, APR, permissões de trabalho, investigação de acidentes.
    • Segurança em armazéns, docas, empilhadeiras, amarração e movimentação de cargas.
    • Noções de saúde ocupacional e eSocial.
    • Combate a incêndio e brigada; plano de emergência e simulados.
    • Ergonomia aplicada a logística e operações frigorificadas.
  • Ferramentas:
    • Pacote Office/Google e ferramentas de checklists/auditorias digitais.
    • Sistemas de gestão de SST/SESMT e eSocial.
  • Habilitações/cursos desejáveis:
    • Instrutor NR-35/NR-33, brigada de incêndio, direção defensiva.
    • Noções de ISO 45001 e ISO 14001; primeiros socorros.
    • CNH B; disponibilidade para viagens.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Foco em segurança e cuidado ativo; presença em campo.
  • Comunicação clara e didática com públicos diversos.
  • Influência e negociação para gerenciamento de mudanças.
  • Organização, senso de urgência e disciplina na gestão de planos de ação.
  • Colaboração e postura consultiva com atendimento personalizado, alinhada aos valores DeLuna.
  • Integridade, confidencialidade e respeito às pessoas.

Diferenciais

  • Vivência em operações e-commerce/last mile.
  • Experiência com gestão de transportadores terceiros e auditorias de clientes.
  • Participação em projetos de certificação e programs de cultura de segurança.

Responsabilidades e Atividades

1) Governança SST e Compliance

  • Atuar como integrante do SESMT conforme dimensionamento da NR-04.
  • Implementar e manter o PGR com inventário de riscos e plano de ação; apoiar as avaliações de exposição conforme NRs vigentes.
  • Apoiar a CIPA no dimensionamento, capacitação e cronograma anual; organizar SIPAT.
  • Gerir EPI/ EPC: especificação, distribuição, rastreabilidade, controle de vida útil e treinamentos.
  • Assegurarconformidade com NRs aplicáveis às operações DeLuna.
  • Acompanhar legislação aplicável ao transporte e logística e requisitos de clientes.

2) Operações de CDs, XPts e Transit Points

  • Realizar inspeções de rotina e emitir relatórios com planos de ação.
  • Validar layout seguro, sinalização, rotas de pedestres/empilhadeiras, proteção de estruturas, housekeeping.
  • Conduzir análises ergonômicas pontuais e propor melhorias.
  • Inspecionar sistemas de combate a incêndio e suportar brigada de incêndio;
  • Verificar condições de câmaras frias e EPIs térmicos em operações frigorificadas.

3) Transporte Rodoviário (FM/MM/LM, LH)

  • Apoiar programas de direção defensiva, análise de rotas críticas, gestão de fadiga e pausas.
  • Realizar inspeções de frota focadas em segurança.
  • Verificar documentação e treinamentos obrigatórios de motoristas e ajudantes conforme a legislação aplicável.
  • Conduzir DDS e blitz de segurança em pátios e pontos de apoio.
  • Investigar sinistros rodoviários e quase-acidentes, propondo ações corretivas e lições aprendidas.

4) Saúde Ocupacional e eSocial

  • Interface com PCMSO e Médico do Trabalho: exames admissionais, periódicos, retorno ao trabalho e mudança de função.
  • Apoiar os eventos do eSocial em conjunto com RH/DP e colaboradores.
  • Apoiar a elaboração de laudos e avaliações por profissionais legalmente habilitados, providenciando dados e acompanhando planos de ação.

5) Treinamentos, Cultura e Comunicação

  • Planejar, ministrar e/ou coordenar treinamentos obrigatórios e específicos.
  • Gerenciar a matriz de capacitação, controles de validade e reciclagens; garantir 100% de aderência.
  • Conduzir campanhas e comunicações de segurança, reforçando os valores e a cultura DeLuna.

6) Emergências e Preparação/Resposta

  • Manter plano de emergência atualizado: cenários em armazéns, câmaras frias, incêndio, vazamento de combustíveis, sinistros rodoviários.
  • Realizar simulados periódicos com brigada e times operacionais; alinhar com corpo de bombeiros e contratadas.
  • Garantir kits de emergência, fichas de segurança e contatos úteis disponíveis e atualizados.

7) Gestão de Terceiros e Fornecedores

  • Qualificar, auditar e acompanhar prestadores sob critérios de SST; verificar documentos, treinamentos e indicadores.
  • Incluir requisitos de SST em contratos e SLAs em parceria com Suprimentos e Jurídico.
  • Acompanhar execução de manutenção predial e de equipamentos por terceiros com Permissão de Trabalho quando aplicável.

8) ESG e Melhoria Contínua

  • Contribuir para metas ESG.
  • Apoiar auditorias internas/externas e requisitos de clientes;
  • Liderar investigação de incidentes com metodologia estruturada e garantir a eficácia das ações.

title: Senior Designer
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

Darkroom is looking for a Senior Designer who’s ready to roll up their sleeves and dive deep into brand, performance, and product design. We’re looking for more than just execution, we’re looking for perspective. You ask smart questions, push creative thinking, and know how to bring ideas to life in a way that’s both strategic and visually sharp.

This role is for someone confident leading creative projects across a range of deliverables, from landing pages and retention flows to paid ads and digital branding, while staying grounded in strategy and results.

You’ll work closely with Retention Managers, Developers, and Designers to deliver polished work that balances brand and performance. You’ll lead initiatives independently while collaborating often, and communicate directly with clients, presenting designs, leading workshops, and managing approvals.

You’ll report to our Director of Creative and work directly with fast-growing brands where the stakes and opportunities are high. This role is designed for someone ready to take on more ownership, broaden their skills across disciplines, and grow quickly within a team that values both creativity and clarity.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone.

What You’ll Do

  • Design digital assets that support a range of client marketing initiatives briefed by a Marketing Manager: paid ads, email & SMS, landing pages, organic social, Amazon creative, and more.

  • Create design systems based on a client’s brand guidelines to be used across multiple channels, ensuring consistency of a client’s brand identity, look, and feel.

  • Communicate with clients directly and present designs on calls, lead clients through workshopping, and obtain approvals while maintaining a strong working relationship.

  • Develop a deep understanding of what factors drive customers to convert on different marketing channels and execute designs within established best practices.

  • Collaborate closely with team members and clients for feedback and approvals to ensure your work adheres to a high standard of craft.

  • Design landing pages within Figma by using UI/UX best practices and adhering to Darkroom’s web design guidelines.

  • Collaborate with project managers and developers to deliver web design initiatives such as landing pages, web design updates, and more.

  • This role is on the Creative team and reports to the Design Director. You’ll work alongside a team of 8+ Designers, each supporting their own roster of 5+ client accounts.

Requirements

Hard Skills:

  • 3+ years of proven design work experience (agency or design studio experience is preferred)

  • Digital portfolio that demonstrates strong branding & identity, visual design, marketing design, and/or web design.

  • Proven understanding of design principles including layout, hierarchy, color theory, typography, and composition.

  • Strong ability to lead client calls, drive workshopping sessions, and manage a client relationship directly.

  • Strong proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite is required.

  • Fluency in English is required. Candidate must be proficient in speaking, writing, and presenting work to clients in English.

Soft Skills:

  • Highly creative individual who strives for detail-oriented design and can execute comfortably in a number of styles.

  • Excellent communication skills

  • Can effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and turn project requirements into compelling designs.

  • Self-motivated and proactive with a strong sense of ownership and accountability for detail-oriented deliverables.

  • Systematic thinker, who problem solves and time manages without heavy direction.

Nice to Have

  • Advanced knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite

  • BFA or higher degree in Graphic Design or Fine Arts

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote , employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model , including weekly in-office appearances . Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

About Us

At Zyte, we eat data for breakfast and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte. Founded in 2010, we are a globally distributed team of over 250 Zytans working from over 28 countries who are on a mission to enable our customers to extract the data they need to continue to innovate and grow their businesses. We believe that all businesses deserve a smooth pathway to data. For more than a decade, Zyte has led the way in building powerful, easy‑to‑use tools to collect, format, and deliver web data, quickly, dependably, and at scale. Over 3,000 companies and 1 million developers rely on our tools and services to get the data they need from the web.

Zyte is seeking an experienced Team Lead to manage our Core & MLOps Squad, responsible for “Building the bedrock infrastructure that powers Zyte at scale.” This hands‑on technical leadership role requires expertise across MLOps, systems programming, and orchestration to lead a cross‑functional team in designing and maintaining the scalable foundation that enables all Zyte teams to build and run their services with confidence.

Technical Leadership

  • Design and evolve the core platform (Kubernetes, Mesos, GPU scheduling/autoscaling, distributed compute)
  • Own the model platform: registry, experiment tracking, training orchestration, evaluation, serving, and monitoring
  • Build the Golden Path: reference repos, a scaffold CLI, opinionated CI/CD pipelines, runtime contracts (health/metrics/tracing/SLOs), high‑performance clients, circuit breakers and other production‑ready defaults

MLOps Excellence

  • Operate a secure, multi‑tenant model registry and training platform with standardized experiment/evaluation harnesses
  • Provide turnkey serving patterns (online + batch), drift/quality monitoring, and rollback playbooks
  • Integrate public/open‑source AI capabilities as managed platform services with cost and data‑governance guardrails

Team Management

  • Run the squad: roadmap/prioritization, delivery, mentoring, and high engineering standards
  • Partner with product engineering (Zyte API, Scrapy Cloud), Prod Ops, and Security on adoption and rollout plans
  • Mentor the team and foster a platform‑thinking mindset

Ownership Areas

  • Container orchestration (Kubernetes/Knative), GPU provisioning & autoscaling, environment & secret management
  • Operators, sidecars, and internal SDKs/libraries (Go/Rust/Python/Java) that enforce the golden path contract
  • Model platform: registry, experiment tracking, training orchestration, evaluation framework, serving infra, model monitoring
  • Observability: logging/metrics/tracing pipelines
  • Billing pipeline: metering/events/cost tracking abstractions
  • Golden Path: Java, Python, ML templates + CI/CD blueprints + docs + scaffold CLI
  • Reliability enablement (SRE practices), cost governance, supply‑chain security (SBOM, image signing)

Qualifications

Required
  • 5+ years experience building distributed systems; 3+ years in MLOps/ML platform engineering (or equivalent impact)
  • Knowledge of Linux/OS internals (process model, cgroups/namespaces), networking (TCP/IP, HTTP/2), concurrency, and performance profiling
  • Deep understanding of Kubernetes (bonus: Mesos)
  • Proficiency developing high‑performance services in Java, Rust, Go or C++ (bonus: familiarity with vert.x and Netty frameworks); strong Python skills
  • Experience with GPU infrastructure (scheduling, containerization, optimization)
  • Track record of designing and operating model platforms (registry, training, serving, monitoring) in production
  • Demonstrated success leading technical teams and implementing organization‑wide platform solutions
Preferred
  • Streaming & workflows: Kafka plus Argo/Temporal/Airflow or equivalents
  • eBPF‑based observability, perf tooling, or io_uring experience
  • Cost optimization for ML/AI; multi‑tenant quotas and fairness
  • Hands‑on experience authoring Golden Paths (service chassis/templates, CI/CD blueprints, CLI scaffolds)
  • SRE practices (SLIs/SLOs, incident management)

Benefits

  • We love fostering and nourishing new ideas and bringing them to market
  • Become part of a self‑motivated, progressive, multi‑cultural team
  • Have the freedom and flexibility to work from where you do your best work, as we are a completely remote company
  • Get the chance to work with cutting‑edge open‑source technologies and tools

1GLOBAL is a technology‑driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best‑in‑class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world's leading banks, corporations, and digital‑first businesses—including neo‑banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.

Position Overview

As an Architect inside the Network Engineering department, you will act as a Solution Architect for new products, services and technologies in 1GLOBAL, acting as a point of contact towards internal and external customers. Effectively work closely with Product and Marketing, but also with all different technical stakeholders and vendors, in shaping, designing, testing, and implementing new solutions. The Architect is responsible for leading the requirements analysis process, in close contact with all relevant stakeholders, to a refined and clear scope, allowing a solution to be created, documented and planned to be implemented.

We are open to hiring for this position in São Paulo, Brazil. The successfully hired candidate will receive onboarding and training in Lisbon, gaining valuable skills while experiencing one of Europe's most dynamic and renowned cities.

Fluency in English is essential for this role. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English as part of your application.

Key Responsibilities

  • Iterates with the customer (internal and external) and other stakeholders to determine the technical requirements, risks, technical impacts, and recommendations
  • Design of new consumer and corporate telecom solutions
  • Collaborates with technical teams in defining reliable, modular, scalable, and customer‑centric solutions, as well as planning and reviewing solutions
  • Design and present solutions in documents and workshops. For the solution identifies the impacts, efforts and the resources needed
  • Market prospection of new solutions through elaboration and analysis of Request for Information/Proposal/Quotation processes and negotiation with potential suppliers
  • Follow up of new technology trends in the Telecom industry and identifying interesting solutions for the product portfolio
  • Definition and follow up of company technological evolution roadmaps
  • Documents the existing technology portfolio and proposes recommendations for improvements and / or alternatives
  • Ensure and control quality of documentation execution (HLD's, LLD's, WO's, etc.)
  • Ensure and control implementation quality. Understanding of End to End system testing requirements
  • Ensure the network is compliant with industry standards and regulations
  • Capacity and Performance Analysis, Reporting and Improvement Solution Definition
  • Work on complex solutions that influence the design of current products and addresses design issues for future products or technologies. Enhance, simplify, and optimize existing applications and processes
  • Evolves the engineering maturity to be on par with the non‑functional and functional state‑of‑the‑art
  • Communicates transparently to the whole business
  • Reaches out to other teams and works towards alignment and overall continuous improvement

Requirements

Must Have

  • Excellent understanding of Mobile Networks and its architectures
  • Experience with MVNO architecture(s) and landscape. Familiar with roaming environment, including its technical, commercial and regulatory aspects
  • Solid knowledge of networking principles & protocols, including security
  • Experience in network protocols like MAP, CAMEL, SIGTRAN, DIAMETER, SIP
  • Knowledge and experience of OCS and Gy/Sy interfaces
  • Experience with VoLTE and VoWiFi
  • Experience with LTE, 5G, IMS, IP technologies and protocols
  • Familiar with cloud‑based solutions and virtualization technologies
  • High Level Designs and Low Level Designs. Experience developing and presenting internal and external documents
  • Experience with 5G Core Mobile Networks
  • Experience with monitoring tools and protocols in Mobile Networks
  • Anticipates problems and addresses them before they cause impact
  • Understands how big‑picture goals inform technical details and vice‑versa
  • Ability to work in complex environments (multi‑cultural/multi‑country/geographically distributed teams)
  • High attention to detail. Doesn't leave things to be addressed or left undone
  • Business oriented, capable to engage and discuss with non technical persons in order to create technical requirements
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • English proficiency mandatory, other languages are a plus
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience

Nice to Have

  • Experience with cloud applications monitoring and analytics is a plus
  • Experience with AI/ML cloud based service assurance is a plus
  • Extensive working experience on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks

Benefits

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)!

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year‑on‑year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast‑paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting‑edge field
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results‑driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

Embedded Linux Field Engineering Manager (Americas only)

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

We are hiring an Embedded Linux Field Engineering Manager to lead a regionally‑focused team of Field engineers in Presales and Professional Services activities, by helping customers with solution architecture, design and delivery.

Location: This is a remote role, running a team in one of three Geos (Americas, EMEA, or APAC). You will therefore need to be located in one of those three Geos to manage that specific team that spans a few time zones from you.

Our Internet of Things mission is to enable companies to make fleets of very secure connected devices. Canonical provides the base Ubuntu OS and kernel, with secure update and management mechanisms. Our customers create mission‑critical control systems, gateways and appliances that need to meet stringent quality and security requirements, and we aspire to bring this level of security to the wider consumer electronics and device market.

Our Field Engineers are thought leaders helping our customers solve hard problems. They are accomplished technologists that take a hands‑on approach to embedded Linux strategy and delivery. They have a passion to help customers achieve ambitious technical and business goals, and to show how the Canonical approach to open source and connected devices brings best‑of‑breed thinking to the emerging field of edge compute. They also care to develop their colleagues, helping them deepen their understanding of the technology, their ability to manage time, and their awareness of customer business thinking for continuous improvement and personal development.

This career opportunity requires a unique blend of skills. Successful candidates will know Linux well and be proficient coders and scripters. They will have experience of low‑level Linux boot, BIOS, firmware and embedded software development methodologies. They also enjoy the pace of change and diversity of client engagements with driven and ambitious technology entrepreneurs. Competitive, business‑focused technologists at heart, they are also team drivers that take pride in team and company wins.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop a team of Field engineers, ranging from graduate to senior, in the areas of Presales and Professional Services

  • Identify and measure team health indicators

Qualifications

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university

  • Extensive embedded Linux experience – Yocto or other
  • Extensive Linux experience – Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • Fluency in at least one of Golang, Python, C, C++, or Rust
  • Ability to manage a small team
  • Experience with customer engagements
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Result‑oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • An ability to communicate the business benefits of technology
  • An humble learner and quick study

Other desirable traits include RTOS experience, additional languages (both the programming and human kinds), and previous experience working in a remote‑first, diverse, distributed company.

Benefits

  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence — in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. The Testing Consultancy (TTC) is a global specialist software testing company with a focus on helping organizations transform the way they deliver quality software. The primary purpose of the Bilingual SAP Tosca Consultant role is to lead and deliver SAP testing and TOSCA automation services to customers using industry standards and best practices to meet TTC customer requirements. The Bilingual SAP Tosca Consultant will work collaboratively to build and establish the overall QA process with a focus on SAP landscapes and model based test automation through TOSCA. Responsibilities for this position also include mentoring QA personnel on SAP testing methodology, TOSCA frameworks, automation strategies, and other technical aspects. The Bilingual SAP Tosca Consultant may also assist in general application support of SAP production applications and systems, managing relationships with business owners, software vendors, auditors, and internal IT teams.

The ideal candidate will have strong SAP functional knowledge, deep hands on experience with TOSCA automation, and the ability to lead both functional and technical discussions. They must be proactive, strategic, technically strong, and capable of performing hands on work as required.

Responsibilities

  • Consult with the customer on the design and implementation of comprehensive Test Activities across SAP modules and TOSCA automation that satisfy Test Objectives and ensure sustainable product Quality throughout the SDLC
  • Advise on all aspects of QA including SAP specific best practices, establishing metrics, applying leading TOSCA automation strategies, and developing tools and processes to meet quality goals
  • Develop, plan, execute, and maintain SAP test cases, TOSCA scripts, plans, and protocols for solutions under development
  • Participate in the deployment of SAP enhancements, upgrades, integrations, and major implementations
  • Complete User Acceptance Testing to validate the end to end business flow across SAP modules
  • Identify opportunities for SAP test process optimization and TOSCA framework improvements with a focus on continuous improvement and customer value
  • Establish and evolve formal QA processes for SAP projects ensuring that the team is using best practices and scalable TOSCA automation approaches
  • Act as a key point of contact for all QA aspects of SAP releases and TOSCA automation delivery while managing customer expectations
  • Work with project management to meet SAP testing milestones and deliver high quality automated and manual testing solutions on time
  • Lead, collaborate, and mentor QA team members on SAP testing methods and TOSCA automation best practices while sharing domain knowledge to expand team capabilities

Technical Skills

  • Hands on experience with TOSCA automation including modules, test case design, execution, and automation framework development
  • Strong knowledge of SAP modules such as FIORI, MM, PM, SD, FICO, PP and QM, BW, EWM, BPC, APO, or others
  • Experience automating SAP applications using TOSCA including navigation, test case recording, and building reusable automation assets
  • Excellent verbal and written communication with the ability to explain SAP and TOSCA technical concepts to internal and external stakeholders
  • Leadership skills with the ability to mentor QA professionals in SAP testing and TOSCA automation
  • Ability to work independently, meet SAP project timelines, and adapt to changing requirements
  • Experience with SDLC including SAP business planning, data analysis, functional requirements analysis, and application design
  • Strong decision making and problem-solving skills related to SAP functional and TOSCA automation challenges
  • Ability to evaluate information from multiple SAP sources, assess risks, prioritize user needs, and design appropriate test solutions
  • Experience working in Agile and Waterfall development environments
  • Knowledge of large-scale SAP deployments, implementations, support, and upgrade projects

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Information Systems, or Computer Science
  • 7+ years of experience in Software Development and Quality Assurance including User Acceptance Testing, Functional Testing, Performance Testing, Manual and Automated Testing. UAT experience is required
  • 3-6 years of SAP Functional Testing experience
  • 2-4 years of hands-on TOSCA automation experience
  • ISTQB Certification preferred

If your experience or qualifications are similar to our ideal candidate, please consider applying. Experience comes in many forms, skills may be transferable, but passion for your career cannot be substituted. At TTC, we recognize the value of diversity and the unique perspectives it brings. We encourage everyone to apply.

The Senior Manager Event Logistics ensures the most favorable conditions for the successful establishment & implementation of the Event Logistics project within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.   • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with the involved government authorities to ensure the smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking not only within the warehouse but across all venues in which assets provided by Logistics
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing these requirements and delivery
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities, movements of team luggage and equipment to / from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities
  • Managing the entry to venues of delivery and collection vehicles during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS)
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including un‑/loading services, determining the storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside the venues, providing of FFE
  • Where / if required development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP) and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM)
  • Procurement and management of golf carts pool at venues
  • Development of a dissolution strategy, in cooperation with the tournament management, legal, procurement and all item procuring functional areas
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking, and people resources as required
  • Manage the established contracts (LSP, FFE‑ and golf carts provider) and ensure all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met

  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics budget in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics project plan, management (including mitigation) and communication of risks and issues in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Recruitment of the Logistics team and providing leadership to this team
  • Prepare and manage a health‑and‑safety plan
  • Prepare and manage a sustainability and environmental plan related to the Event Logistics Project
  • Provide timelines and accurate reporting to FIFA Zurich Event Logistics and Senior Management
  • Complete the final reconciliation, close the contracts and transfer the knowledge post‑tournaments

YOUR PROFILE

  • Team player, willing to work to tight timelines
  • Strong analysis, reporting and data skills
  • Able to work in a fast‑paced, multi‑level, project‑based event environment with emphasis on timelines and delivery

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Benefits

  • Work‑Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Division of Urogynecology, the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology at Howard University College of Medicine is seeking a passionate and highly organized Research Associate with strong expertise in research coordination, community engagement, qualitative research, and/or implementation science. This individual will play a critical role in advancing research initiatives that address pelvic floor disorders, health disparities, and women’s health outcomes among underserved populations in the DMV area.

The ideal candidate is committed to Women’s Health, capable of managing research operations, and skilled at building trust and sustained engagement with community stakeholders. This position reports to the Division Chief of Urogynecology.

Supervisory Authority

Responsible for orienting and training others, and assigning and reviewing their work. May also be responsible for acting in a lead or senior capacity over other positions performing essentially the same work or related technical tasks and reporting to a higher level on a formal basis.

Nature And Scope

To coordinate and execute studies, to establish internal and external contact with Division/Department staff, researchers, trainees, and outside vendors for the purpose of gathering and exchanging information.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Coordinate the day-to-day operations of clinical, translational, and community-based research studies.
  • Prepare and submit Institutional Review Board (IRB) protocols, amendments, and continuing reviews.
  • Oversee recruitment, enrollment, informed consent, and data collection procedures.
  • Maintain high standards of research integrity, regulatory compliance, and participant confidentiality.
  • Collaborate with investigators on data analysis, manuscript development, and conference abstracts.
  • Utilize REDCap, Qualtrics, and other platforms to manage and monitor data.
  • Support the development and application of implementation science frameworks to improve uptake of evidence-based interventions.
